about: The difficulty budget (docs/design/difficulty-budget.md): win-rate bands for each fight kind, for a hero who keeps up with the road, played by the casual and the good player of tools/budget.mjs. tools/health.mjs --compare gates each hero (Wren, Tobin, Pip) on these bands. Loosening anything here (a band, a gap's limit or until) needs a judge and a change-log line in the doc; a routine re-baseline does not.
toleranceNote: a hero cell's tolerance is max(tolerance, 2.5 x its sd over the baseline's seed offsets)
meanTolNote: the three-hero mean may not move further from its band than max(meanTol, 2.5 x its sd)
tobinBossNote: Tobin's casual band on boss kinds sits this much higher (capped at 1): he is the safest hero (DECISIONS.md)

normal.note: a foe between bosses (a chain of 5, HP carried)

elite.note: an elite foe (a trait and an extra move), from zone 15

firstBoss.note: zone bosses 1-3, while the player learns to parry and dodge

captain.note: a zone boss from zone 11 (the Captain tier)

champion.note: an area boss (the Champion tier; once boss-tiers builds it)

elder.note: a region boss (the Elder tier: the Fenmother at zone 35)

behind.note: its ref boss with every worn piece a gear tier behind: casual wins drop 10-60 points against the ref row (gear matters), and a good player still wins 60%+ (skill carries, no hard walls)

joined.note: report only (proposed band, gate once a judge sets it): a hero who just took the lamp (road level, the lamp's gear, signature only, no Stars) against the hero who kept it, at the same boss: casual wins drop at most 30 points, and a good player still wins 90%+ (rotating never stalls the road)

build.note: report only (proposed band): every attribute point in one attribute against the even spread, at the same fight: within 15 points of casual wins either way (shape, not power); budget.mjs also prints the turns ratio

firstChampion.note: the zone 5 Champion, the first real test of the first hour (boss-tiers judge 2026-10-07); firstChampion sits on the first-hour set

keptUp.note: report only: a kept-up hero (tier at the zone, rare +5) at zones 8, 10, 12, 13 and 15 against the first-hour row. Out-gearing the first hour feels strong; the check is that gear never makes the boss harder (kept-up casual >= first-hour casual minus tolerance); after the pr4 move sets (tricks, rally gates, own-HP floor) it still wins 92-100% at z8-15: the 96% defender cannot be beaten without breaking the hit cap. Owner: boss-tiers-pr5 (zones 16-34 tricks, floor and gate retune), until 2026-11-15. The relative check (gear must help) is gated in tools/health.mjs

reportCaptain.note: report only: zone 4 (its boss knot rises; unmeasured before 2026-10-07)

floor.note: report only: nothing worn at the zone 10 Champion; skill must carry (casual 10%+, good 95%+)

floor5.note: report only: nothing worn at the zone 5 Champion (casual 35%+; do not re-create the 983e9f5 zone 5 stall)
